blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Defense lawyers of former President Rodrigo Duterte have challenged at the International Criminal Court (ICC) the prosecution’s bid to introduce multiple witnesses, including one who supposedly has evidence on the inner workings of the Davao Death Squad (DDS). In a Sept. 11 filing released only on Sept. 22, the defense told Trial Chamber III that the evidence from the witness, referred to as “P-1100,” is “neither sufficiently relevant nor probative of the facts in dispute in this case.” Last month, prosecutors, citing Rule 68(3) of the ICC Rules of Procedure and Evidence, asked the chamber to allow them […]...
